rounds.text: Clio Infotech is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.16x compared to a sector benchmark of 1.94x [E2, E7]. This valuation gap is further supported by a discounted cash flow analysis suggesting an intrinsic value of Rs 14 per share, providing a 29.3% margin of safety at the current price of Rs 9.59 [E29, E30]. The company has demonstrated a remarkable turnaround in operational efficiency, with operating margins improving by 420 percentage points over the last three years and maintaining an increasing yearly trend [E18, E20]. Furthermore, the business is conservatively financed with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.22x, and it has successfully reduced its total borrowings over the past year [E23, E24]. While the stock has shown strong momentum with 89% growth over the last year, the market has yet to fully price in the company's aggressive sales growth of 2129% [E16, E37]. Conceded: the company faces challenges with a negative cash conversion cycle, high debtor days of 440, and a lack of promoter shareholding [E22, E35, E26]. Despite these risks, the current valuation remains disconnected from the company’s improving sales and profit trajectory [E37, E39].
